examples.english: Apparently he really likes his job.
examples.persian: ظاهراً او واقعاً شغلش را دوست دارد.

miniContext: Apparently means according to what you have heard or read.

examples.english: Presumably he earns a lot more working in London.
examples.persian: احتمالاً با کار کردن در لندن حقوق خیلی بیشتری می‌گیرد.

miniContext: Presumably means used to say that you think sth is probably true.

examples.english: Ultimately, I think he does it more for his career than the money.
examples.persian: در نهایت، فکر می‌کنم این کار را بیشتر برای شغلش انجام می‌دهد تا پول.

miniContext: Ultimately means finally; when everything has been considered.
Fair enough (informal) is used to say that an idea or suggestion seems reasonable.

examples.persian: صادقانه بگویم، فکر می‌کنم دیوانه است.

miniContext: Frankly means used to show that you are saying what you really think about sth.

examples.english: I don't entirely agree with you.

miniContext: Entirely means in every way possible; completely.

examples.english: Basically that is where we are different.
examples.persian: اساساً ما از این نظر با هم فرق داریم.

miniContext: Basically means used when giving the most important fact.

examples.english: His career means practically everything to him.
examples.persian: شغلش تقریباً همه‌چیز برای او است.

examples.english: Strangely, he wasn't all that ambitious when we were at school.
examples.persian: عجیب اینکه، او وقتی مدرسه بودیم آنقدرها هم جاه‌طلب نبود.

miniContext: Strangely (enough) means used to show that sth is surprising.

meaning: برای مدت کوتاه / در چند کلمه

examples.english: I briefly explained the concept to him.
examples.persian: آن مفهوم را در چند کلمه برایش توضیح دادم.

miniContext: Briefly can mean for a short time, or in a few words.

examples.english: She said she came to my training session purely out of interest.
examples.persian: گفت صرفاً از روی علاقه به جلسه‌ی آموزشی‌ام آمده.

examples.english: Smoking is strictly prohibited in here.
examples.persian: سیگار کشیدن اینجا قاطعانه ممنوع است.

miniContext: Strictly can mean exactly and completely, or used to emphasize that sth must happen in all circumstances.

examples.english: I don't know precisely how it happened.

miniContext: Invariably is used to emphasize that sth is always true or always happens.

examples.english: The restaurant is primarily for tourists.
examples.persian: این رستوران عمدتاً برای گردشگران است.

miniContext: Simply can be used to emphasize a statement, or mean in a way that is easy to understand.
